optimizedContext.value:
# GetSpecMetadata
## Rules
### Input and delegation
- `execute({ specId })` → `MaterializeSpecMetadata` with `policy: 'if-needed'`. No own freshness/gen/persist logic.
### Result contract
- Same as MaterializeSpecMetadata: SpecMetadata, metadataFingerprint, source (`persisted`|`generated`), regenerated, warnings (incl. metadata-cache-write-failed). MUST NOT narrow/rename/drop fields.
### Failure semantics
- Typed failure only if valid in-memory projection impossible, or read of spec/artifacts/lock fails. Cache-write failure → warning on success, not hard fail.
### Construction
- Standard Core UC: GetSpecMetadataDeps, resolveGetSpecMetadataDeps (at least MaterializeSpecMetadata), createGetSpecMetadata(deps), createGetSpecMetadata(config, options?) via CompositionResolver.
## Constraints
- Thin facade over MaterializeSpecMetadata if-needed; no alternate freshness policy.
